diwali.about: Diwali is the festival of lights celebrating the victory of good over evil.
diwali.story: It marks the return of Lord Rama to Ayodhya after defeating Ravana.
diwali.rituals: Lakshmi Puja, lighting diyas, decorating homes, bursting crackers.
diwali.significance: Symbolizes light over darkness and knowledge over ignorance.

holi.about: Holi is the festival of colors and spring.
holi.story: Based on Prahlada and Holika, symbolizing victory of good over evil.
holi.rituals: Holika Dahan, playing with colors, singing and dancing.
holi.significance: Celebrates love, joy, and renewal of relationships.
